skill.summary: Helps you audit your wardrobe, define a personal style formula, and build a versatile capsule using items you already own to simplify daily dressing.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Personal Style Capsule skill.

- Guides you to audit your wardrobe based on real-life scenarios.
- Helps define your personal style formula (preferred silhouettes, colors, fabrics).
- Produces a capsule plan: what to keep, fill (missing items), and retire.
- Focuses on practical organization using what you own, not trend-driven advice.
- Outlines clear safety boundaries against overconsumption and appearance judgment.
